lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਏ ਪੇਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਖਾਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: tripat aghaae pekh prabh darasan a(n)mrit har ras bhojan khaat ||
lines.translation: I am satisfied and satiated, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan. I eat the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's sublime food.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਤ ॥੨॥੪॥੮੪॥
lines.transliteration: charan saran naanak prabh teree kar kirapaa sa(n)tasa(n)g milaat ||2||4||84||
lines.translation: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of Your Feet, O God; in Your Mercy, unite him with the Society of the Saints. ||2||4||84||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਅਪਨੇ ਜਨ ਆਪ ॥
lines.transliteration: raakh leee apane jan aap ||
lines.translation: He Himself has saved His humble servant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਨੋ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਗਏ ਸਭ ਸੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa har har naam deeno binas gae sabh sog sa(n)taap ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: In His Mercy, the Lord, Har, Har, has blessed me with His Name, and all my pains and afflictions have been dispelled. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਸਭਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਰਾਗ ਰਤਨ ਰਸਨਾ ਆਲਾਪ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun govi(n)d gaavahu sabh har jan raag ratan rasanaa aalaap ||
lines.translation: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, all you humble servants of the Lord; chant the jewels, the songs of the Lord with your tongue.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਨਿਵਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣਿ ਆਤਮ ਧ੍ਰਾਪ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kot janam kee trisanaa nivaree raam rasaain aatam dhraap ||1||
lines.translation: The desires of millions of incarnations shall be quenched, and your soul shall be satisfied with the sweet, sublime essence of the Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਗਹੇ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਜਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪ ॥
lines.transliteration: charan gahe saran sukhadaate gur kai bachan jape har jaap ||
lines.translation: I have grasped the Sanctuary of the Lord's Feet; He is the Giver of peace; through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, I meditate and chant the Chant of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਗਰ ਤਰੇ ਭਰਮ ਭੈ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥੨॥੫॥੮੫॥
lines.transliteration: saagar tare bharam bhai binase kahu naanak thaakur parataap ||2||5||85||
lines.translation: I have crossed over the world-ocean, and my doubt and fear are dispelled, says Nanak, through the glorious granduer of our Lord and Master. ||2||5||85||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾਪੁ ਲਾਹਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: taap laahiaa gur sirajanahaar ||
lines.translation: Through the Guru, the Creator Lord has subdued the fever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਪਨੇ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ਜਿਨਿ ਪੈਜ ਰਖੀ ਸਾਰੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur apane kau bal jaaee jin paij rakhee saarai sa(n)saar ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to my True Guru, who has saved the honor of the whole world. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਬਾਲਿਕੁ ਰਖਿ ਲੀਨੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar masatak dhaar baalik rakh leeno ||
lines.translation: Placing His Hand on the child's forehead, He saved him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਦੀਨੋ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: prabh a(n)mrit naam mahaa ras deeno ||1||
lines.translation: God blessed me with the supreme, sublime essence of the Ambrosial Naam. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਲਾਜ ਰਖੈ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: daas kee laaj rakhai miharavaan ||
lines.translation: The Merciful Lord saves the honor of His slave.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥੨॥੬॥੮੬॥
lines.transliteration: gur naanak bolai daragah paravaan ||2||6||86||
lines.translation: Guru Nanak speaks - it is confirmed in the Court of the Lord. ||2||6||86||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਦੁਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੭ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag bilaaval mahalaa 5 chaupade dupade ghar 7 ||
lines.translation: Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl, Chau-Padhay And Dho-Padhay, Seventh House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਉਜਾਰੋ ਦੀਪਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sabad ujaaro deepaa ||
lines.translation: The Shabad, the Word of the True Guru, is the light of the lamp.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਤਿਹ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਰਤਨ ਕੋਠੜੀ ਖੁਲੑੀ ਅਨੂਪਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: binasio a(n)dhakaar tih ma(n)dar ratan kothaRee khulhee anoopaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: It dispels the darkness from the body-mansion, and opens the beautiful chamber of jewels. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਮਨ ਬਿਸਮ ਭਏ ਜਉ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bisaman bisam bhae jau pekhio kahan na jaai vadiaaee ||
lines.translation: I was wonderstruck and astonished, when I looked inside; I cannot even describe its glory and grandeur.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਗਨ ਭਏ ਊਹਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਤੇ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਲਪਟਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: magan bhae oohaa sa(n)g maate ot pot lapataaee ||1||
lines.translation: I am intoxicated and enraptured with it, and I am wrapped in it, through and through. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਲ ਜਾਲ ਨਹੀ ਕਛੂ ਜੰਜਾਰਾ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਨਹੀ ਭੋਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aal jaal nahee kachhoo ja(n)jaaraa aha(n)budh nahee bhoraa ||
lines.translation: No worldly entanglements or snares can trap me, and no trace of egotistical pride remains.

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਚਨ ਊਚਾ ਬੀਚੁ ਨ ਖੀਚਾ ਹਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਮੋਰਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: oochan oochaa beech na kheechaa hau teraa too(n) moraa ||2||
lines.translation: You are the highest of the high, and no curtain separates us; I am Yours, and You are mine. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ਏਕੈ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: eka(n)kaar ek paasaaraa ekai apar apaaraa ||
lines.translation: The One Creator Lord created the expanse of the one universe; the One Lord is unlimited and infinite.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਬਿਸਥੀਰਨੁ ਏਕੁ ਸੰਪੂਰਨੁ ਏਕੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ek bisatheeran ek sa(n)pooran ekai praan adhaaraa ||3||
lines.translation: The One Lord pervades the one universe; the One Lord is totally permeating everywhere; the One Lord is the Support of the breath of life. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੂਚਾ ਸੂਚੋ ਸੂਚਾ ਸੂਚੋ ਸੂਚਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: niramal niramal soochaa soocho soochaa soocho soochaa ||
lines.translation: He is the most immaculate of the immaculate, the purest of the pure, so pure, so pure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤ ਨ ਅੰਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਬੇਅੰਤਾ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਊਚੋ ਊਚਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੮੭॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)t na a(n)taa sadaa bea(n)taa kahu naanak oocho oochaa ||4||1||87||
lines.translation: He has no end or limitation; He is forever unlimited. Says Nanak, He is the highest of the high. ||4||1||87||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਤ ਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin har kaam na aavat he ||
lines.translation: Without the Lord, nothing is of any use.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਚਿ ਮਾਚਿ ਤੁਮੑ ਲਾਗੇ ਓਹ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਮੋਹਾਵਤ ਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa siu raach maach tumh laage oh mohanee mohaavat he ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You are totally attached to that Enticer Maya; she is enticing you. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਨਿਕ ਕਾਮਿਨੀ ਸੇਜ ਸੋਹਨੀ ਛੋਡਿ ਖਿਨੈ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਵਤ ਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kanik kaaminee sej sohanee chhod khinai mahi jaavat he ||
lines.translation: You shall have to leave behind your gold, your woman and your beautiful bed; you shall have to depart in an instant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਰਝਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਰਸ ਪ੍ਰੇਰਿਓ ਬਿਖੈ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਖਾਵਤ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: urajh rahio i(n)dree ras prerio bikhai thagauree khaavat he ||1||
lines.translation: You are entangled in the lures of sexual pleasures, and you are eating poisonous drugs. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਕੋ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਸਾਜਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਓ ਪਾਵਕੁ ਤਲੈ ਜਰਾਵਤ ਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: trin ko ma(n)dar saaj savaario paavak talai jaraavat he ||
lines.translation: You have built and adorned a palace of straw, and under it, you light a fire.

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸੇ ਗੜ ਮਹਿ ਐਠਿ ਹਠੀਲੋ ਫੂਲਿ ਫੂਲਿ ਕਿਆ ਪਾਵਤ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: aise gaR mahi aith hatheelo phool phool kiaa paavat he ||2||
lines.translation: Sitting all puffed-up in such a castle, you stubborn-minded fool, what do you think you will gain? ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਮੂਡ ਪਰਿ ਠਾਢੇ ਕੇਸ ਗਹੇ ਫੇਰਾਵਤ ਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)ch doot mood par thaadhe kes gahe pheraavat he ||
lines.translation: The five thieves stand over your head and seize you. Grabbing you by your hair, they will drive you on.
